design.hypothesis: Causal evidence from opposite observed factual actions can route equal-capacity fast memory in an unmarked familiar context switch, without receiving a context identifier or schedule as a predictor input.
design.null: Inferred routing does not outperform shared memory and constant/action routing on either known context recall; errors, inference lag and oracle gap must be retained.
design.fixture: Two fixed public algebraic action-effects, common sensor +0.07 and elapsed time +0.2; intercept +0.05; oppositely signed slopes +0.45/-0.45, same marginal action +/-1; 24 events each context, 96 per order.
design.source_of_context_evidence: Only completed factual (action, observed_next) pairs. The posterior sign is inferred from half the difference between latest positive and negative action outcomes; no simulator/world label, phase number or future target enters inference.
design.inference_pair_requirement: Both action polarities actually observed; initial tie-break +; fixed slope magnitude threshold 0.2; update only after each factual outcome.
design.outcome_scoring: All arms score real factual next sensor before receiving any outcome. Counterfactual prediction may be read from same prior state but alternate outcome is never observed/trained.
design.oracle_role: ONLY a known-latent-context upper bound, not a fair automated learner.
design.negative_controls: Shared unmodified original, action-sign partition, constant sensor-sign partition (cannot distinguish worlds), and no-feedback.
design.controls_frozen: All arms same untrained native model parameters, sensor/action/time stream and recurrent/history dynamics. Different mask selection and runtime computations declared.
design.infer_correctness: Rate of correctly selected latent contexts BEFORE outcome (ground truth used only after predictions for diagnostic scoring).
design.phase_change_latency: Count errors at time of switches, record inference change receipts; initial two factual results anticipated after fresh context switch.
design.acceptance: Engineering integrity only, including matching 12-slot capacity and causal chronology, complete records/negative outcomes, Windows/WSL full exact-SHA regression, and original source negatives; hypothesis support may be zero and must be reported.

science.S26_predecessor: Original first-use scientific negative preserved, never replay seeds

limitations: Fixed synthetic action alternation and deterministic two-context algebraic targets
A learned causal-effect sign is a hand-coded on-line estimator, not learned representation inference or JEPA
Same marginal observation distributions but known actions + realized outcomes reveal latent slope after pair; no unfamiliar-world novelty
Equal stored scalar capacity does not guarantee matched wall/compute operations; oracle uses true latent label
Model weights not trained, no retention beyond same familiar worlds, no authentic source custody
